question: Which tools are associated with defects?

candidates.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . }
SELECT ?tool WHERE { ?defect a :Defect . ?material CONTAINS ?defect . ?processStep REQUIRES ?tool . ?material USED_IN ?processStep . ?tool a :Tool . }
SELECT ?tool WHERE { ?defect a :Defect . ?processStep REQUIRES ?tool . ?lot REQUIRES ?processStep . ?lot HAS_DEFECT ?defect . ?tool a :Tool . }
